test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Four living things have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one odd one.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic:** Except Eagle all others are mammal.**

 
• **Dog** – A mammal that lives on land.
 
• **Cat** – A mammal that lives on land.
 
• **Monkey** – A mammal that lives on land.
 
• **Eagle** – A bird that primarily lives in the air and can fly.

Dog, Cat, Monkey are all mammals, whereas the **Eagle** is a bird.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Eagle**".
